reden: Yes. The audit report explicitly identifies the same issue: in AccountingLibrary.getCreditAmountIn() the swap fee for sellCreditMarket with exactAmountIn=false is charged on the net cash instead of the gross amount, leading to under-collected protocol fees and inconsistency with the exactAmountIn=true path. This matches the vulnerability description’s root cause, code path (sellCreditMarket -> getCreditAmountIn), impact (lower-than-expected fees), and the fix (compute fees on gross/divide by 1 - fee). Therefore, fixing the audit-reported issue would also fix the described vulnerability.
